# Daily Report — 2026-09-30

## Task Completed
Added `list_ci_dependency_groups` and `get_ci_dependency_group` tools (cmdb_dep_group table).
Dependency groups define named sets of CIs sharing a common failure domain or tracked together
for impact analysis. `list_ci_dependency_groups` supports name/group_type/active filters plus
raw query passthrough and has_more pagination. `get_ci_dependency_group` fetches a single record
by sys_id with 404 and empty-result guards. Reference fields (manager, type, sys_class_name)
normalised to display values. Both tools registered in `__init__.py`, `tool_utils.py`, and
`config/tool_packages.yaml` under `system_administrator` and `full` packages.
